application_id.description: Unique identifier of the application evaluated

category.description: Application approval category (e.g. EOA_RENEWAL, INCREASE_INTAKE, NEW_INSTITUTE)

workflow.description: Application workflow status dimension. VALIDATED_NO_ISSUES is restricted to complete passes of the full active rule set, full issuer verifications, and OCR quality gates; partial demo runs must use scoped statuses like NO_FINDINGS_IN_ENABLED_DEMO_CHECKS.

decision_support_only.description: Always true. The prototype informs officers; it never issues approvals or sanctions.

simulated.description: Always true for synthetic fixtures and demo environments.

rule_set.description: Identifier of the rule checklist applied (e.g. EOA_RENEWAL-demo-v1)

rule_set_version.description: Version string of the rule set applied (e.g. 1.0.0)

checks_not_evaluated.description: List of pipeline capabilities or handbook areas not covered in this evaluation

findings.description: List of actionable findings or discrepancy indicators
